gate.basis: H1.1 historical evidence contract (instrument, lookback, freshness, 05:00 clocks)
reasons: VIX close: FRED VIXCLS is an alias for the Cboe VIX close, but the archive stores neither the Cboe record nor a receipt clock. The 05:00 availability is unproven.
DGS2 5d: Only the five-interval change is stored. The five DGS2 observations, their vintages and clocks are absent, so the change cannot be reconciled to H1's declared transform.
US-DE 2Y spread 5d: No DGS2-minus-Bundesbank spread is present in the H1 input fields. The archive cannot construct the declared five common-interval change or its clocks.

DFII10 5d: The archive stores only the five-interval change. The five DFII10 observations and their vintages were absent until the 2026-11-20 acquisition read the Treasury's Daily Treasury Real Yield Curve history directly.
DTWEXBGS 5d: Only the five-interval return is stored. The five DTWEXBGS observations and their vintages are absent, so the return and its clocks cannot be verified.

DXY.cash 05:00 return: no value in the archive; The archive holds the completed-hour DXY.cash tape from 2024-12-10 (10052 bars). The 05:00 London value is the bar that closes at the cutoff, so it needs no lookahead; but the broker prints no bar on a weekend or holiday boundary, and the export carries no publication receipt. A morning without its own 05:00 bar is blocked, never filled from a neighbouring hour.
LBMA gold PM 5d: The legacy gold return is derived from an OANDA XAU/USD quote, not the LBMA Gold Price PM USD auction. The instrument identity fails before the missing five fixings are considered.
QQQ close 5d: The legacy return is the Nasdaq-100 index, not the QQQ ETF's official close. The instrument identity fails, and the five closes and split adjustment are absent.

Release calendar: Only the FOMC statement archive is staged. CPI, Employment Situation, advance GDP, Personal Income and Outlays schedules are absent, so the event window cannot be answered for the complete declared calendar.

h1_missing_evidence.issue: Release calendar: Only the FOMC statement archive is staged. CPI, Employment Situation, advance GDP, Personal Income and Outlays schedules are absent, so the event window cannot be answered for the complete declared calendar.
h1_missing_evidence.action: Acquire complete archived BLS, BEA and Federal Reserve schedules for CPI, Employment Situation, advance GDP, Personal Income and Outlays and FOMC decisions. Record each release timestamp and collector receipt.

recoverable_gaps.label: VIX close
recoverable_gaps.recoverable: Cboe daily close history and release calendar can reconstruct the publication timestamp; recipient receipt cannot be reconstructed.
recoverable_gaps.acquisition: Acquire the Cboe VIX official close history and the collector receipt at 05:00 London. Retain the exact close used and its observed/published/received clocks for every session.

recoverable_gaps.label: DGS2 5d
recoverable_gaps.recoverable: FRED ALFRED vintages reconstruct the publication series; recipient receipt at 05:00 London cannot be reconstructed from the archive.
recoverable_gaps.acquisition: Acquire the H.15 DGS2 daily series with ALFRED vintages and the five raw observations behind each change. Record publication and collector receipt clocks.

recoverable_gaps.label: US-DE 2Y spread 5d
recoverable_gaps.recoverable: Both publication series are public and can reconstruct the spread and publication times; no receipt clock is archived.
recoverable_gaps.acquisition: Acquire H.15 DGS2 and Bundesbank BBSIS 2.0-year Svensson zero-coupon spot histories. Compute the spread only on common observation dates and retain all five operands, publication times and collector receipts.

recoverable_gaps.label: DFII10 5d
recoverable_gaps.recoverable: The published value and a publication time no earlier than the publisher's stated release time are reconstructable. A recipient receipt at 05:00 London cannot be reconstructed from a historical archive.
recoverable_gaps.acquisition: Read the Daily Treasury Real Yield Curve 10-year column for every business day in the run window and retain the five completed intervals behind each change. A receipt is required only for sealed live replay.

recoverable_gaps.label: DTWEXBGS 5d
recoverable_gaps.recoverable: FRED ALFRED vintages reconstruct the publication series; recipient receipt at 05:00 London cannot be reconstructed.
recoverable_gaps.acquisition: Acquire the H.10 DTWEXBGS daily series with ALFRED vintages and the five raw observations behind each return. Record publication and receipt clocks.

recoverable_gaps.label: DXY.cash 05:00 return
recoverable_gaps.recoverable: Publication at the cutoff is proven by the completed bar itself. A recipient receipt cannot be reconstructed from a retrospective export, so sealed live replay stays blocked for this input.
recoverable_gaps.acquisition: Collect the DXY.cash 05:00 bar close live at the cutoff and record a genuine receipt, so this input can also enter the sealed lane. No ICE licence is required and none is requested.

recoverable_gaps.label: LBMA gold PM 5d
recoverable_gaps.recoverable: LBMA auction records reconstruct the PM publication time; the archive contains neither the auction records nor a receipt.
recoverable_gaps.acquisition: Acquire the LBMA Gold Price PM USD auction history (do not substitute OANDA XAU/USD). Retain five completed fixings, publication timestamps and collector receipts. Access is licensed: the LBMA prices page read on 2026-11-20 states an IBA licence is required to obtain and use historical benchmark data, so this is a paid-access decision, not a free download.

recoverable_gaps.label: QQQ close 5d
recoverable_gaps.recoverable: Nasdaq official close history reconstructs the publication time; the archive contains neither the official closes nor a receipt.
recoverable_gaps.acquisition: Acquire Nasdaq official QQQ closing prices (not the Nasdaq-100 index) and five completed closes, split-adjusted as known at each cutoff. Record publication and receipt clocks.

recoverable_gaps.label: Release calendar
recoverable_gaps.recoverable: Official schedules and release timestamps reconstruct the published release times; collector receipt times are not archived.
recoverable_gaps.acquisition: Acquire complete archived BLS, BEA and Federal Reserve schedules for CPI, Employment Situation, advance GDP, Personal Income and Outlays and FOMC decisions. Record each release timestamp and collector receipt.

event_calendar.note: The staged archive carries fomc_statement; 4 of 5 required release types are absent. A zero event count under this partial calendar cannot establish that no omitted release occurred.

control.directions_scope: Directions retained on non-blocked engine records: allowed directional calls plus directional abstentions. A blocked record withholds its direction as NO_CALL, so these are not the raw engine-v1 flags.

performance.note: No outcome is attached to these decision records. A blocked morning does not enter a denominator, and no directional call has been scored by this run.

h1.directions_scope: Directions retained on non-blocked engine records: allowed directional calls plus directional abstentions. A blocked record withholds its direction as NO_CALL, so these are not the raw engine-v1 flags.

performance.note: No outcome is attached to these decision records. A blocked morning does not enter a denominator, and no directional call has been scored by this run.

published_book.note: These are the engine-v1 artefact's published flags, not gated calls. The shared engine withholds direction and trade on blocked mornings. A published flag on a blocked or abstained morning is an audit finding; it is never counted as a trade.

sample_reconciliation.classification: blocked = evidence failed at a blocking check; abstained = every blocking check passed and the model declined; directional = allowed with BULLISH or BEARISH; no_call_allowed = allowed with NO_CALL. Performance is not scored until a directional denominator survives the gate.
